newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks start consolidation, small caps shine.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks start consolidation, small caps shine.

text.p: MADRID, Nov 18 (Reuter) 1630 GMT - Madrid stocks ended slightly lower on Monday as a much-needed consolidation process started, dealers said.
* General index down 0.55 points, 0.14 percent, to 389.19
* Selected small caps posted large gains, but otherwise consolidation was widespread and should continue short-term.
Ibex could trickle down to 4,400, dealers said.

* Speculation on upcoming changes to electric sector still moving key firms, but end effect still impossible to quantify, dealers said. Fecsa, Sevillana closed unchanged after posting nine month results.
Madrid stocks ended slightly lower on Monday as a much-needed consolidation process started, dealers said.
Selected small caps posted large gains, but otherwise consolidation was widespread and should continue short-term.
The Ibex could trickle down to 4,400, dealers said.
The general index fell 0.55 points, 0.14 percent, to 389.19 and the Ibex shed 6.21 points, 0.14 percent, to 4,483.69.

Speculation on upcoming changes to the electric sector was still moving key firms, but dealers said the end-effect is still impossible to quantify. Fecsa and Sevillana closed unchanged after posting nine month results.
"The session was really quiet, with less money than paper but with few fears of a correction," said one dealer.
But another disagreed, saying that the indices need to consolidate recent gains in order to try for new highs now that most nine-month results are out.
"We're really crying out to cut back before having a go at fresh highs," the trader said.
